description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Notify the Revenue Protection Order No. 02 of 2018, which specified Import Duties on Gold.
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a resolution passed by Parliament under Section 10 of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new import duty rates on specific articles (gold in various forms). It involves the creation of regulatory frameworks for customs duties and import regulations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions government officials (Secretary of Ministry of Finance and Mass Media), this is incidental to the primary purpose of establishing legal/regulatory changes to customs duties.
